Definition: Zebadjah, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zebadiah is a name carried by nine different men in the Old Testament, from Benjamites in the tribal lists to a Levite gatekeeper and a prince of Judah under Jehoshaphat. Two of them stand out in the verses here: the son of Asahel who commanded David's army in its monthly course, and the son of Michael who came home from exile with Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of faithful servants even when nine men share one name, because each one served in his own place. The name means the LORD has given, and every Zebadiah in the lists is a reminder that God gives His people the men they need.
RelatedPeople: Zebadiah, Son of Asahel; Zebadiah, Son of Michael; King David; Ezra
